hypothesis: Compare new early-event and breakout candidates by existing fixed-reference strength divided by max(initial stop distance, ATR)/signal-close price; keep fixed scores, thresholds, stops, held/carried rights and execution unchanged. Risk inputs must be finite and dated before execution. Anticipated cost: favoring quiet but slower trends.

--- a/quantfusion/engine/ensemble_allocation.py
+++ b/quantfusion/engine/ensemble_allocation.py
@@ -616,10 +616,40 @@
         eligible_new = set(admission_scores) & (
             (score_eligible & confirmation_eligible) | set(transition_candidates)
         )
+        # New slots compare the same fixed-reference evidence per unit of
+        # planned initial downside. An existing stop is not a guaranteed fill;
+        # ATR prevents a nearly zero stop distance dominating this comparison.
+        # Held books and carried obligations retain their existing rights.
+        initial_risks: dict[str, float] = {}
+        unknown_risk: set[str] = set()
+        for state in states:
+            for signal, _ in state.pending:
+                if signal.direction != "buy" or signal.symbol not in eligible_new:
+                    continue
+                try:
+                    price = float(signal.price)
+                    stop = float(signal.stop_loss)
+                    atr = float(signal.atr)
+                    stamp = pd.Timestamp(signal.signal_date)
+                    valid = (
+                        all(math.isfinite(value) for value in (price, stop, atr))
+                        and price > stop > 0. and atr >= 0.
+                        and not pd.isna(stamp) and stamp < date
+                    )
+                except (TypeError, ValueError):
+                    valid = False
+                if not valid:
+                    unknown_risk.add(signal.symbol)
+                    continue
+                risk = max(price - stop, atr) / price
+                initial_risks[signal.symbol] = max(
+                    initial_risks.get(signal.symbol, 0.), risk,
+                )
+        eligible_new &= set(initial_risks) - unknown_risk
         ranked = sorted(
             eligible_new,
             key=lambda symbol: (
-                -admission_scores[symbol],
+                -admission_scores[symbol] / initial_risks[symbol],
                 EXECUTION_PRIORITY.get(symbol, 9999),
                 symbol,
             ),
